response.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE UA IS NOT NULL AND UA > 3.9 GROUP BY ID) SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_of_avg_hgb, AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_of_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM per_patient;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff selects records with UA strictly greater than 3.9; the request gives a cutoff but not its direction.
APTT minus PT is computed per record, so records missing either APTT or PT are skipped for that average. HGB is averaged independently over records with non-null HGB.

alternatives.interpretation: The selected records are those with UA at or below 3.9 (low uric acid) instead of above it.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE UA IS NOT NULL AND UA <= 3.9 GROUP BY ID) SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_of_avg_hgb, AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_of_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM per_patient;
